source.author: ov
source.text: Sic dicere vates faticinasque ferunt sortes quantumque recordor, dixerat Aeneae, cum res Troiana labaret, Priamides Helenus flenti dubioque salutis:
source.text_original: Sic dicere vates / faticinasque ferunt sortes quantumque recordor, / dixerat Aeneae, cum res Troiana labaret, / Priamides Helenus flenti dubioque salutis:
source.text_english: Thus, the seer and the prophetic lots are said to have spoken, and, as far as I recall, when the Trojan cause was wavering, the son of Priam, Helenus, had said to the weeping Aeneas, uncertain of his safety:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: accelerat sed summa dies Asiamque labantem linquimus et poscunt iam me sua tempora Grai.
reuse.text_original: accelerat sed summa dies Asiamque labantem / linquimus et poscunt iam me sua tempora Grai.
reuse.text_english: He hastens on, but the last day is near, and we leave Asia in its decline, and now the Greeks claim their own time from me.
